entries.interpretation: The $214,049,995 is the advance-funding cash subscription, not the purchase-cost numerator. The SEC filing's historical-cost table records $214,000,000 for the 84,365,876.3625 XRP lot, and the incorporated issuer press release reports $2.53657058 per XRP. That reported price reconciles to the rounded $214,000,000 historical cost, not to the full $214,049,995 subscription cash. The disclosure reviewed here does not itemize the $49,995 difference; do not assign it to fees or claim the full subscription cash was spent on the XRP lot.
